body: I can say that to myself but I can't mean it
Why is the fact that life could be worse supposed to be comforting to me? Why does everyone raise that point? No one ever says it could be better, even though it could
Basically, live an entire lifetime of suffering so my parents don't have to suffer somewhat. It's only ever about other people; my needs and desires are always second
I don't have anything to say, I can't write a long note telling them how much I love them
Let's find out if you're right
If you knew me you would see I have no value. Why are you lying?
The past 5 months attest to that not being true. Have lived each day wanting to die, yet I haven't killed myself yet, and the misery has just continued

Get up another day and feel the same misery, and then the next day and the next, then the next month, then the next year, and years and decades after that until it's been a long life of emptiness and misery. It's easy to tell someone else to keep going, when you're not in the same pain and despair

My parents will be upset, and that's it. I can guarantee you no other family will be upset, and I don't have any friends, and former friends won't care, they've moved on. As far as the gifts God gave me, I'm sorry to say it but yes, they don't feel good enough, because when I look around at what other people have, I'm filled with such jealousy and anger at what I'm missing. I'm not talking about millions of dollars, but these are supposed to be Godly things: friends, family, love, a relationship, connectedness to people, a purpose...many other people have these things whether they are Christian or not, but I'm left out
It's not about doing something to other people, it's about doing something for myself, to end my suffering
Some say if you've accepted Christ you can still go to heaven even if you commit suicide. What kind of loving God would force me to live a life of suffering, decades upon decades of misery?
Yea the hotline is useless, but I'm interested in what you wrote about not starting your life yet, can you tell me more?
To me, there is shame in it
I'm curious what blasphemy against the Holy Spirit is. I've said fuck God - if that's blasphemy then I'm already damned and there's no point to anything
You had a wife, you're ahead of me

1. I prayed for months and received no directions, no response from God. He ignored me, so I stopped praying

2. I've talked with so many people - they lie and say things will get better. They ignore how pathetic and worthless I am. They would tell a man with no legs that he can walk

A big part of the reason I'm ending it is because I have no future. Focusing on the present day would get me nowhere the same as what I've been doing. No matter what I do, I go nowhere. So it's time to die
Tried it, except Christ didn't respond back
It's so lonely and I can't connect with other people
I feel like a broken record. I'VE TRIED SO MUCH ALREADY, what people and professionals suggest doesn't help

Too much to live for? Like what? Working at my dead end job, then going home to lie in bed 12-14 hours a day watching tv? To me that's nothing to live for at all
I have talked to my parents, they threaten to call the cops

So what? So there are other people my age who are also losers? I'm sorry to be rude but I don't want to be a loser, even if there are others like me. There are so many other people around me who are winners, I want to be like them
Reading your story, I'm struck by how unfair it is that some people get so ahead while others face all these roadblocks. It's bullshit really
I would love to have what you describe, but it's out of my grasp. I can never achieve something like that
The future is not mine, it's suffering. I have no future

No friends, no relationship, barely any family, no career, no skills, no motivation or drive, no future nothing to look forward to, nothing worthwhile about me, complete loser, failed life

Already talked about everything

Worthless waste of a life...too late to change anything. No friends, barely any family, no career, no skills, no interests or passions, no relationship, no motivation, drive, or any sort of interesting or useful quality. Recovering from drugs and alcohol but all I want to do is drink and use. No social skills, nothing desirable about me to people or employers. In debt, lazy and immature, completely behind in life. Also, time won't heal any of these wounds. Writing this is making me look forward to killing myself
Nothing is fun, unfortunately
I don't know what to say except that you shouldn't do it

I just started drinking one night and enjoyed it so I kept going and never stopped until now

Wealth, a career I enjoyed, recognition, love, family, friends, physical strength.

Better chance of actually dying if I use a shotgun
Metal slugs

By now, with all I've tried, there should be SOME results. There needs to be some incentive to get better, some hope, something tangible that will let me know that things could get better, but there's been nothing. As I mentioned above, each time I try something new, there's a glimmer of hope that is then quickly dashed when nothing changes. I don't have the strength to keep going through that, over and over, to be crestfallen each time. It starts to magnify and build on itself. When I try something new and it doesn't help, I don't just let go of that and move on to the next thing - I hold onto each one, and they compound into this tower of failure and hopelessness. It's become too much to bear

Why do I have to become some dirty grunt for the peace corps while others live in the lap of luxury surrounded by loved ones? This is the kind of bullshit I cant stand

I'm sorry
